text_block_list.text:
Today, I came up to the mountains to take 
a break from work. While strolling through 
the lush greenery—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Phew... haah, nice. Choosing mountain 
trails for running was definitely the 
right call.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
C.B.-chan, you're always trying to dash 
into animal trails... Though I have to 
admit, it really does feel wonderful!
choice_data_list: (Those two came out here as well?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Maruzen, look, there's a rest stop 
over there. I'm getting a little hungry, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
—As I was saying, eating onigiri halfway 
up a mountain is a violation of proper 
etiquette!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
Nori and salt are marine products, so 
bringing things of the Sea God into the 
domain of the Mountain God is strictly NG!

text_block_list.name: Hiker
text_block_list.text:
Uh... well, haha, is that so...? I've 
never heard of that before... sorry.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... What a bit of a troublesome 
person.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *Chomp*, munch munch...

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text: Whaaat-?! Y-Y-Y-You! An onigiri...?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Didn't even have time to stop her~. Oh, 
C.B.-chan, really now...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...*Gulp*. Mm, picking salmon was 
definitely the right move.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Watch your step, Maruzen! Looks like the 
middle of the bridge is safe to cross!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
Hold on just a minute—! Were you even 
listening to what I just said?!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
Walking along the edge of a suspension 
bridge is proper etiquette! Walking down 
the middle makes you look arrogant, so one 
must walk along the edge with humility!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
In the mountains, to prevent slipping, you 
must stop and take each step firmly and 
deliberately!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Excuse us, we'll be going ahead! If you 
don't keep a steady rhythm, you won't be 
climbing anything.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text: GYAAAHHH—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
Just who on earth do you think you are?! I 
have never seen anyone so outrageously 
carefree in my life!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
That selfishness is deeply unpleasant to 
those around you! Listen to me and follow 
proper manners!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm not convinced. By anything you're 
saying, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hiker
text_block_list.text: S-She actually said it...?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Swaying an old suspension bridge is way 
more dangerous, and if you can't climb at 
your own pace, you're only gonna wear 
yourself out for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it. Aren't you just slapping 
the word "manners" onto your own personal 
opinions?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see no reason to obey that. I'll think 
with my own head and act accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text: Wh-What did you sayyy?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, that's enough~! It's a 
waste of energy getting so frustrated☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind bad memories would be bad 
for the mountain too, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, Maruzen. I might've done it 
again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're so delightfully clumsy. You 
just can't keep things inside when you 
don't agree with them. In fact, you charge 
right into them head-on—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I love that about you, though♪

She might be completely free-spirited... 
but she has a solid core, and struck me as 
a truly refreshing person. Though that 
also means she likely faces a lot of 
hardships—
choice_data_list:
It's amazing how you stick to your own 
style.

text_block_list.text:
She might be completely free-spirited... 
but she has a solid core, and struck me as 
a truly refreshing person. Though that 
also means she likely faces a lot of 
hardships—
choice_data_list:
It's amazing how you stick to your own 
style.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...You think so? I'm really just following 
whatever my heart tells me.
choice_data_list:
Is following your heart what makes you so 
strong?

Is following your heart what makes you so 
strong?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? If that's what your heart tells 
you, then maybe that's true, huh?

If so, I thought I'd trust my instincts. I 
made up my mind to go and see her running 
once again...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...You think so? I'm really just following 
whatever my heart tells me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...For example, look. A nice breeze just 
picked up. Hey, let's dash all the way 
down the mountain in one go!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You can't hold back the urge to run, after 
all!

A horse girl who is clumsy in her fierce 
honesty to herself. Yet, that very trait 
might be the secret to her strength. I 
resolved to go and witness her running 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Staying quiet hurts a whole lot more. 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's my own life. I'd hate to go through 
it without understanding, without being 
convinced.

A horse girl who is clumsy in her fierce 
honesty to herself. Yet, precisely because 
of that, she possesses great strength. I 
decided to go and witness her running once 
again.
